scope: DEVELOPMENT witness follow-up to PR 222; no calibration or random shots
population: All 924 gained and all 55 shared nonempty single-source syndrome patterns. Compare archived cluster classes also for the 700 others.
geometry: Complete detector vertex sequences for every path in one admissible cluster explanation, including boundary endpoints and pairing. Independent choice of source-component representatives per edge occurrence as in the original existence test.
same_geometry_witness: Two admissible explanations with identical paths, differing by the logical mask of exactly one edge occurrence. Sources/components underlying that edge may differ.
single_site_intervention: Start from syntactic edge/mask support. At selected endpoint pair(s) enable the alternative extra mask. A site is sufficient for an originally single-class cluster iff some complete geometry traverses it. Shot advances only when every cluster has both classes. Count minimum number of distinct sites; certify whether one common site suffices.
control: For shared cases also decide whether two syntactic classes can use the same pairing type or require switching between detector-detector and two boundary assignments.
whole_sources: Compare each syndrome to the logical XORs of all whole single DEM error instructions producing it. Do not infer impossibility under multiple active sources.
tie_break: Use shortest paths in total hops then lexicographic geometry for display. Prefer a flip on a singly used edge if possible. For each step cite the first sorted source_event_id/component_index yielding its policy mask. Counters concern existence, not probability or weights.
